messages.author: 202361017aae64d8
messages.subject: Pricing scheme
parts:
Hello all,

I have just one question: What happens after the 50 hours of activity run out? I'd consider going for the basic version, especially if there's an academic discount, but it's not available yet.

Cheers,

Maria

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Pricing scheme
parts:
Hi Maria,
During the beta period (which will run through January of next year) there will be no limits imposed on anyone.  We will likely have a transition period where beta members who are using paid features will have the opportunity to make adjustments as needed.
Our plan for what happens to applications that run out of hours on the free tier is to present a nice message that indicates that the hours for the month have been consumed and would restart at the beginning of the new month. 
Please let me know if this addresses your question.

Best,
-Tareef
